description.en: Sets the display name shown for a match team, by team slot and a name-table string ID.
Index of the team/side to rename.
Read but not used by the implementation.
Team-name string ID (e.g. "name_te0997", hashed via CRC32) to display.
True once the name has been stored for that team slot (a no-op if the team slot or nameId is invalid); null if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Give team 0 a custom display name for this match
CMND_BTL_SET_TEAM_NAME(0, 1, "name_te0997");
